run_mpc_imagenet_single_process: run encrypted ImageNet inference with a single process using a specified torchvision model
run_mpc_imagenet_multiprocess: run encrypted ImageNet inference across multiple processes with a configurable number of parties
run_mpc_imagenet_on_aws: run encrypted ImageNet inference on AWS EC2 instances using the AWS launcher script
run_experiment_function: run the MPC ImageNet experiment with a specific model, dataset folder, and sample count
configure_multiprocess_launcher: configure and launch a MultiProcessLauncher with a specified world size and experiment function
